THIELE.basis: E. R. Thiele, The Mysterious Numbers of the Hebrew Kings (3rd ed., 1983): Ahab 874-853 BCE, fixed by the Assyrian synchronism of Qarqar (853 BCE, Kurkh Monolith of Shalmaneser III). Nisan regnal-year reckoning assumed for Israel.

Masoretic chain from Thiele's date for the founding of Solomon's temple in his fourth year (966 BCE): the 480th year after the Exodus (1 Kgs 6:1) puts the Exodus c. 1446 BCE; Israel's 430 years in Egypt (Ex 12:40-41, MT) put Jacob's descent c. 1876 BCE; Joseph was then 39 (30 when he stood before Pharaoh, Gen 41:46, then seven years of plenty and two of famine, Gen 45:6), so born c. 1915 BCE. Month unknown. The margin covers a 13th-century Exodus (about 185 years later) and the LXX and Samaritan reading of Ex 12:40, which counts the 430 years from Abraham's arrival in Canaan (about 215 years later).
